modules.title: Project Setup
modules.scope: Siapkan workspace, NestJS Fastify API, config validation, PostgreSQL/Prisma, Redis, EMQX local stack, Swagger, Pino, health foundation, lint/build/test foundation, Docker Compose.

modules.title: Database Foundation
modules.scope: Bangun database foundation, Prisma conventions, initial tenant-aware entities, migration/seed strategy, transaction conventions.

modules.title: Authentication
modules.scope: Implement register, login, refresh rotation, logout, verification architecture, forgot/reset password, session revocation, Argon2id dan JWT guards.

modules.title: User & Tenant Management
modules.scope: Implement profile, tenant/organization membership, tenant context, role/permission foundation dan invitation-ready model.

modules.title: Device Management
modules.scope: Implement registry, profile/type, provisioning identity, pairing, ownership, credential rotation/revocation, heartbeat dan health.

modules.title: MQTT & Device Connectivity
modules.scope: Implement EMQX integration, auth/ACL architecture, topic contract, LWT, ingest boundary, command publish dan correlation.

modules.title: Universal Sensor & Capability
modules.scope: Implement dynamic capability schema, semantic/data type, unit, constraints, readable/writable/reportable dan custom capability.

modules.title: Actuator & Device Command
modules.scope: Implement command lifecycle, dispatch, ack, timeout, correlation, idempotency, history dan writable validation.

modules.title: Telemetry & Time-Series Data
modules.scope: Implement telemetry validation/normalization, latest state, history, retention/partition strategy, aggregation dan query API.

modules.title: Dynamic Dashboard
modules.scope: Implement dashboard/layout/widget schema dan capability-driven card, switch, gauge, chart, map, table, status.

modules.title: Automation Engine
modules.scope: Implement trigger, condition tree, action, evaluation, cooldown, execution log, loop prevention dan idempotency.

modules.title: Scene
modules.scope: Implement scene actions, ordered/parallel execution, history, permission dan partial failure handling.

modules.title: Scheduler
modules.scope: Implement timezone-aware scheduling, cron/time, repeat, countdown, durable execution dan missed-run policy.

modules.title: Notification
modules.scope: Implement notification domain, preference, template, email adapter, webhook-ready abstraction, retry dan delivery status.

modules.title: OTA Firmware
modules.scope: Implement firmware metadata, compatibility, artifact abstraction, checksum, rollout, progress, failure dan rollback strategy.

modules.title: AI Analytics Foundation
modules.scope: Implement analytics contracts, anomaly/recommendation model, feature boundary dan provider-neutral adapter tanpa klaim akurasi palsu.

modules.title: Smart Space Management
modules.scope: Implement site/home, building, floor, room/area hierarchy dan device placement.

modules.title: Device Sharing & Guest Access
modules.scope: Implement invitation, sharing, guest access, expiry, granular permission, revoke dan audit.

modules.title: Organization & Branch
modules.scope: Implement enterprise organization/branch hierarchy dan membership tanpa menduplikasi smart-space domain.

modules.title: Advanced RBAC, Policy & Audit
modules.scope: Implement custom roles, permission/policy evaluation, resource scope, audit query dan cross-tenant negative tests.

modules.title: Public API, Webhook & SDK Foundation
modules.scope: Implement API key lifecycle/scope, webhook signing/retry/log dan SDK-friendly public contracts.

modules.title: External Smart Ecosystem Integrations
modules.scope: Bangun integration framework dan adapter boundaries. Implement provider nyata hanya jika specification/credential context tersedia.

modules.title: System Health & Metrics
modules.scope: Implement liveness/readiness, dependency health, metrics dan safe operational admin views.

modules.title: Observability
modules.scope: Implement correlation propagation, structured logs, tracing-ready context, audit consolidation dan metrics conventions.

modules.title: Flutter Mobile Application
modules.scope: Implement Flutter architecture dan core flows: auth, tenant/site, devices, dynamic capabilities, realtime, commands, cache/offline dan provisioning boundary.

modules.title: Admin Panel
modules.scope: Implement secure admin application untuk users, tenants, devices, health, audit dan usage sesuai frontend ADR.

modules.title: Billing, Subscription, Usage & Quota
modules.scope: Implement plans, entitlement, usage meter dan quota. Provider payment tetap abstraction sampai keputusan eksplisit.

modules.title: Production DevOps & Scaling
modules.scope: Implement production container/CI/CD/deployment foundation, backup/restore, migration deployment dan scaling documentation.

modules.title: Security Hardening
modules.scope: Lakukan threat model dan hardening auth, authorization, MQTT ACL, secrets, abuse controls, dependency security dan security tests.

modules.title: ESP32 Device SDK & Provisioning
modules.scope: Implement ESP32 SDK architecture, identity, Wi-Fi/BLE provisioning, MQTT, telemetry, commands, heartbeat, OTA contract dan secure storage strategy.
